title: feat(spec): a map settings specifier; the lifecycle retention overrides and quotas use it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi59ATBeDy7jECXRUFiXAgGB)_

Refs #30208

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `SpecifierType` gains a member; the save and env doors also start refusing malformed values for the three keys (a narrowing on values that never took effect, named in the PR's BREAKING note)
Metadata-protocol: added — a package author can now declare a `map` specifier in a settings manifest (a new accepted value of `SpecifierType`)
Skills-docs: no skill teaches the specifier set. `skills/**` names `SettingsManifest` once (`skills/objectstack-platform/references/plugin-development.md:355`) and the three lifecycle keys by name only (`skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md:137-139`), never their value form, so nothing a skill teaches changes. Docs updated here: `content/docs/protocol/kernel/config-resolution.mdx` (how an `OS_*` override of a `map` key is judged), and the generated `content/docs/references/system/settings-manifest.mdx`.

> **BREAKING** accept-set narrowing at the settings doors (`@objectstack/service-settings`), for `lifecycle.retention_overrides`, `lifecycle.quotas` and `lifecycle.quota_defaults` only. `PUT /api/settings/lifecycle` and `OS_LIFECYCLE_*` used to accept any object under them, so a misspelt object (`sys_audit_logs`), a quota written as text (`"1e6"`) or zero, a window written as `30 days` or a misspelt column (`max_age`) was stored, answered "saved", and applied nothing. The save door now refuses such a value with `400 SETTINGS_VALIDATION` and one field error that names the entry and the expected form; the env door rejects such an override with one `error` line and the key resolves from the next layer. Every refused value is one the sweep never applied. **Migration:** send keys the deployment has and cells in their column's form: `{ "quotas": { "sys_audit_log": 1000000 } }`, `{ "retention_overrides": { "sys_job_run": { "maxAge": "90d" } } }`; for an override, `OS_LIFECYCLE_QUOTAS='{"sys_audit_log":1000000}'`. Stored values, env names and the cascade are unchanged. ADR-0087 disposition: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, one marker, in `.changeset/30208-settings-map-specifier.md`.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 设置清单新增一种设置项类型 `map`（"一行一个键，后面跟有类型的列"）。「数据生命周期」的保留期覆盖、行数配额、按类默认配额三个设置改用它。存储的值、环境变量名和覆盖层级都不变。保存和环境变量两个入口开始检查这三个值：对象名必须是系统里真有的、声明了生命周期的对象，时长必须写成 `7y` 这种形式，配额必须是大于 0 的整数。ADR-0007 加了一条修订。
- **为什么改：** 以前这三个值存什么都行，对象名拼错、配额写成文字、时长写成 `30 days` 都会显示「已保存」，然后什么都不执行。这是 #30208 第 5 行的裁定 A（田騏 2026-11-08 02:07 「同意」）。
- **风险与回滚：** 以前存进去的错值不受影响，只有保存时碰到这个键才会检查。脚本如果写这些错值会收到 400，环境变量写错会打一条 error，不生效。控制台在 ui 卡落地前会把这三行显示成「不支持的设置项类型」，环境变量和 API 照常可用。回滚方式是 revert。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.zod.ts` 的 `map`、`keyColumn`、`columns`；`packages/services/service-settings/src/map-shape.ts`，以及 `settings-service.ts` 里 `mapShapeVerdict` 的两处调用；`packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-key-options.ts`；`docs/adr/0007-settings-manifest-and-kv-store.md` 的修订。
- **两分钟验证：** `cd packages/services/service-settings && pnpm exec vitest run src/settings-map-shape-30208.test.ts`，16 个应该全过。其中会把拼错的对象名、坏时长、文字配额送进保存口和环境变量口，看它们被拒绝。
- **需要你做的：** 这个 PR 改了 ADR（Tier H），需要你审核并合并。类型名暂定 `map`，由 Fable 复审定。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec`: the `map` specifier.** `SpecifierType` gains `map`, a value-bearing type. `Specifier` gains `keyColumn` (`{ label, description? }`, the key column's header) and `columns` (`[{ name, label, description?, kind }]`, `kind` is `duration` or `positive_integer`). A `map` requires both, with at least one column and unique column names; any other type declaring either is refused at parse. The doc states the storage rule: one value column stores `Record<key, value>`, several store `Record<key, { [column.name]: value }>`. Column names keep the stored property's spelling (`maxAge`), so the type covers today's shapes with no migration. The keys a map admits are served at run time by an option source the settings service registers for the key; every manifest read serves them as the map's `options`, and a declared `options` table is only the fallback. `json` stays for raw config. **Name:** `map` is proposed (it names the `Record` shape the value is; VS Code calls the same thing an object grid); the Fable review settles it.
- **ADR-0007.** Status line amended (2026-11-08, #30208); a `map` row in §Specifier set; `json`'s row now says it is not for maps; a dated note under the set cites ruling record 6715997428.
- **`@objectstack/service-settings`: one shape judgement for both doors (`map-shape.ts`).** `firstMapShapeMiss` judges a value against the declared columns and the key column's domain: not an object at all (`not_a_map`), a key not admitted (`key`), an entry that is not an object or names no column (`not_an_entry`), a property no column declares (`unknown_column`), a cell not of its kind (`cell`). `SettingsService.mapShapeVerdict` reads the domain through the existing `optionTableOf` (a registered source's answer, else the declared table), so a source moves both doors at once. The save door (`validatePatch`) answers one `FieldError` per key: `invalid_type`, `invalid_option`, `unknown_field` or `invalid_shape`, with `constraint: { type: 'map', entry, column?, kind?, allowed? }` and a sentence naming the entry and the form expected (`'sys_job_run'.maxAge must be a duration such as 7y …`). The env door (`effectiveEnvOverride`) rejects such an override through `reportRejectedEnvOverride` with the same sentence; the value is described by its shape, never printed. The option family skips a map key (its table names keys, not the value). A map key without a source is audited at registration; a sourced one is judged when read, and a key-domain miss is held until `sealOptionSources`, as a sourced option is. This subsumes #31279's `jsonShapeMiss` for these three keys: they are no longer `json`, and `jsonShapeMiss` stays for real `json` keys.
- **`@objectstack/objectql`: the lifecycle maps.** `retention_overrides` (columns `maxAge`, `expireAfter`, both `duration`), `quotas` and `quota_defaults` (one `positive_integer` column each) are `map` specifiers, defaults and scopes unchanged. `lifecycle-key-options.ts` serves their keys: `lifecycleObjectKeySource` (the objects whose lifecycle class is not `record`, exactly the set the sweep walks, read at each ask) and `lifecycleClassKeySource` (`LifecycleClassSchema` without `record`). `ObjectQLPlugin` registers the three sources with the settings service at `kernel:ready`, before the manifest. `loadGovernance` reads the same shapes; #31279's legacy-text handling stays.
- **Translations.** The help text of the three keys drops its JSON examples in the ten translation packs that carry them (`ar`, `de`, `es-ES`, `fr`, `ja-JP`, `ko`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `zh-CN`, `zh-Hant`) and in the English manifest copy (`en.ts` has no `lifecycle` block; the manifest literal is the English text). `quota_defaults` names the four classes instead.
- **Docs.** `config-resolution.mdx` says how an override of a `map` key is judged, with two examples. Generated: `content/docs/references/system/settings-manifest.mdx`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/system.json`, the strictness-ledger counts.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/30208-settings-map-specifier.md`, `minor` for `@objectstack/spec`, `patch` for the two services, both declaration lines, the BREAKING section with its migration, and the ADR-0087 marker.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.test.ts` (+6): `map` is in the closed set and an unknown type still throws; a one-column and a several-column map parse, camelCase column names kept; a map without a key, without columns, with an empty column list or without a key column is refused; a column kind outside the set and a duplicate column are refused; `columns` / `keyColumn` on another type are refused; `json` still parses.
- `packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-map-shape-30208.test.ts` (16), over real `ObjectQL`, the platform setting objects, the real route, the shipped `lifecycleSettingsManifest` and the two key sources: the manifest lists no keys and the namespace read serves them as `options`; the shapes the sweep reads are stored unchanged; a misspelt object, a `record` object, an object with no lifecycle, the `record` class and a misspelt class are `invalid_option`; `30 days`, `"1e6"`, `0` and `2.5` are `invalid_shape`; `max_age` is `unknown_field`; an entry naming no column is `invalid_shape`; JSON text is `invalid_type`; a clear falls back; a stored malformed value does not block an unrelated save; env JSON text of an admitted map is in force, while a misspelt object, a bad duration and unparseable text are not, each with one `error` line.
- `packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-json-shape-31241.test.ts` (8, unchanged in substance): now over a raw-config manifest with `json` keys, since no shipped manifest declares one.
- `packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-key-options.test.ts` (6): the object source admits exactly the swept objects, reads storage objects when present, admits an object registered later, answers nothing without a registry; the class source omits `record`; booted through a real `ObjectKernel`, `ObjectQLPlugin` registers the three sources before the manifest, and they admit an object the stack registered.
- `packages/services/service-settings/src/__tests__/settings-door.testkit.ts`: the door scaffolding the #31241 suite carried, shared by both suites.

## Acceptance notes

- **Name.** `map` is proposed; alternatives considered were `keyed_rows` and `table`. Renaming is mechanical (the enum member, the superRefine branch, `declaredMapShape`'s type check, the manifest, the ADR row).
- **Column labels are English literals.** Translating them needs a `columns` group in the settings `keys[key]` translation entry and ui's copies of that schema; that belongs with the console control (ui card body in the report), not here.
- **`retention_overrides` columns are not judged against the object's declared policy.** An override of `expireAfter` on an object with no `ttl` block is admitted, as the sweep simply has nothing to apply it to. Narrowing per column would need the source to answer per column; not part of ruling A.
- **The console** draws the three keys as "Unsupported specifier type: map" until the ui card lands. The order puts `ui/**` out of scope.
- **The claim's file surface** names `skills/**` lines (none needed changing) and does not name `content/docs/protocol/kernel/config-resolution.mdx`, `content/docs/references/**`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/system.json` or the strictness-ledger counts; the first is the env paragraph this change extends, the rest are generated by the spec gates.
- **Branch.** The merge queue deleted `claude/project-thread-4ntp5s` when #31279 landed, so the branch was recreated from `main` at `b85190a8` with this work on top, then `origin/main` (`2ba7a9d4`) merged in; nothing of #31279 is re-carried.

## Verification

Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on head `32b54d4d` (mutation landed, the suite red, restored blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty after each), against `settings-map-shape-30208.test.ts` (16):

| # | Mutation | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| B1 | a misspelt key accepted: `mapShapeVerdict`'s `admitsKey` → `undefined` | 4/16: the misspelt object, the `record` / no-lifecycle objects, the `record` and misspelt class at the save door, and the misspelt object at the env door |
| B2 | a bad duration accepted: `cellFits`' duration check drops `LIFECYCLE_DURATION_REGEX` | 2/16: `30 days` at the save door and at the env door |
| B3 | an env value bypasses the judgement: the env door's map verdict → `null` | 3/16: the misspelt object, the bad duration and the unparseable text are in force |

Local runs, all on the final head `32b54d4d` (the `origin/main` merge at `2ba7a9d4` included), under `os-verify-lock`: `@objectstack/spec` test 912 files / 27528 tests, exit 0; `@objectstack/objectql` test 569 files / 11501 tests, exit 0; `@objectstack/service-settings` test 73 files / 1397 tests and typecheck, exit 0; `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/objectql` typecheck (test layer included), exit 0; `pnpm lint`, exit 0.

**Gates, on `32b54d4d`:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 121 commands, each run with stdin from /dev/null after a full `packages/**` build, all `:: exit 0`. `--ran`: "121 derived, 121 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". The round before the merge caught `check:error-code-casing` (field codes in the new test, now marked `adr0112-ok: D6`) and `check:slot-lookup` plus an eslint `no-restricted-syntax` on an `as any` in the kernel wiring test (removed); both green here.

**Dogfood, full battery on `32b54d4d`:** every `packages/**` package built, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock, no shard and no path: `Test Files 437 passed | 3 skipped (440)`, `Tests 3618 passed | 41 skipped (3659)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
